lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Zuri Goldstein is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Zuri Goldstein is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Zuri kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Zuri's gone." Carolina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Zuri." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Declan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Zuri Goldstein, 41 days. The mantle passes to Declan Liang.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Declan Liang, 26 — a roofer. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Berserker Rage, Green Thumb, Literally.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Zuri — and Zuri is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Carolina, Nathan, Annelie and 3 more speak for Declan — "Zuri trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Declan before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
